title: EDHOC x5c handshake over 1-hop TSCH (server=root node1, client=node2)

test.description: 1-hop baseline for the M1 latency-vs-hops sweep (X.509 x5chain, cert inline). node1 = x5c server + RPL root + TSCH coordinator; node2 = x5c client (direct neighbour). Read the client's 'EDHOC finished' timestamp. Same multi-hop client firmware as the 2/3-hop configs; at 1 hop the ASN-drift tolerance is a no-op.
